title: Sharing joy through a changing mood

captions.physics: Openly participating in a pleasant exchange
captions.emotions: Feeling shared enjoyment change its rhythm

meaning: An available exchange supports leisure when wanting private certainty leaves room for enjoyment to change naturally between both people.
text: Open joy need not stay at one height. The Sun in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes visible participation and exchanging pleasure. The Hermit in energy leans towards withdrawing until an inward impression becomes definite. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions brings changing enjoyment: livelier, quieter and interesting again. Both may struggle to accept this rhythm without explaining every turn. Leaving exchange at the first dip can make an ordinary shift in mood seem like losing every possibility of pleasant company.

For example, you show each other amusing photographs. Laughter gradually quietens and one wants silence to understand what changed. **Changing enjoyment can stay shared without a complete explanation.** You can offer one calm detail or say a little pause appeals. This preserves contact with actual interest. Both need neither restore the earlier brightness immediately nor separately seek a final meaning for each quieter response.

The difficulty is making change a reason to disappear from the meeting. You examine your state more closely while the other knows less about available continuation. Mood changes without shared participation. A brief invitation keeps choice open. Sometimes another photograph appeals; sometimes quiet suffices. Joy can have different phases without demanding a constant identical reaction. Both can remain present while discovering what this part of the evening offers.
